01784 Diynaye' (亞蘭文) {di:-na:-ye:'}

種族名稱, 字源不詳; 陽性專有名詞 族名

欽定本 - Dinaites 1; 1

底拿人 = "審判"
1) 他們在北國十支派被擄後, 被安置在撒馬利亞的城市中 (#拉 4:9|)

01784 Diynay (Aramaic) {dee-nah'ee}

patrial from an uncertain primitive;; n pr m

AV - Dinaites 1; 1

Dinaites = "judgment"
1) the name of some of the Cuthaean colonists who were placed in
   the cities of Samaria after the captivity of the ten tribes
